analysis.summary: For the financial year ended March 31, 2025, Ravileela Granites Limited reported total income of Rs. 4,246.65 Lakhs, representing a 25% growth compared to Rs. 3,393.29 Lakhs in the previous financial year. However, net loss widened to Rs. 320.79 Lakhs due to increased raw material costs without corresponding sales price increases and notional fair value losses on investments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company recorded total income of Rs. 4,246.65 Lakhs for FY25, achieving 25% growth over the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year ended 31st March 2025, the Company’s total income stood at Rs. 4,246.65 Lakhs, registering a growth of 25% as compared to Rs. 3,393.29 Lakhs in the previous financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Management proposes exploring strategic partnerships and alternative funding avenues to support capacity expansion and market reach.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, exploring strategic partnerships and alternative funding avenues is proposed to support capacity expansion and market reach.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in net loss was caused by higher raw material costs without matching sales price increases, as well as a notional fair value loss adjustment on investments.
margins_costs.quote: The increase in loss on account of increased raw material costs without corresponding increase in the sales price as well on account of adjustment of notional fair value loss on the investments.

margins_costs.claim: The loss for the financial year ended March 31, 2025 stood at Rs. 320.79 Lakhs compared to a loss of Rs. 60.04 Lakhs in the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: The loss for the year was Rs 320. 79 lacs as against a loss of Rs. 60.04 lacs.

margins_costs.claim: The company's finance cost decreased by approximately 19.05% during the period under review.
margins_costs.quote: Finance cost of the Company during the period under review has been decreased by approximately 19.05%.

capital_allocation.claim: The board did not recommend any dividend for FY25 due to losses incurred during the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year under review, the Company has incurred losses, therefore no dividend has been recommended by the Board.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not buy back any of its securities during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not bought back any of its securities during the year under review

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not provide any loans, guarantees, or make new investments during the financial year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not given any loans, Guarantees or made any investments during the financial year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained its investment of 15,11,000 equity shares in B2B Software Technology Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues its investment in 15,11,000 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each of B2B Software Technology Limited.

capital_allocation.claim: The board did not recommend any dividend for the financial year under review due to the incurred losses.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year under review, the Company has incurred losses and therefore no dividend has been recommended by the Board.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company periodically reviews its cyber security maturity and enhances processes and technology controls in response to increased cyber attack scenarios.
risks_headwinds.quote: In view of increased cyber attack scenarios, the cyber security maturity is reviewed periodically and the processes, technology controls are being enhanced in-line with the threat scenarios.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company did not experience any cyber security incidents, breaches, or data losses during the year under review.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, your Company did not face any incidents or breaches or loss of data breach in cyber security.

management_commitments.claim: Management proposes exploring strategic partnerships and alternative funding avenues to support capacity expansion and market reach.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, exploring strategic partnerships and alternative funding avenues is proposed to support capacity expansion and market reach.
